title: Delhi govt launches PM Surya Ghar portal; NDMC clears EVs, Ayush hospital, civic projects
source: Government News | Latest news on eGovernance, Digital India, Smart Cities | ET Government : ETGovernment.com
summary: The key decisions include a one-time amnesty scheme on late payment surcharges for pending water bills, mandatory electric vehicle (EV) procurement for all new council vehicles, and in-principle approval for a 50-bedded Ayush hospital in Sarojini Nagar, according to NDMC Vice-Chairman Kuljeet Chahal.

title: Delhi to launch 150 electric buses next month, seeks land for five depots
source: Government News | Latest news on eGovernance, Digital India, Smart Cities | ET Government : ETGovernment.com
summary: The government has sought land at Tikri Kalan, Jaunti, Mungeshpur, Bakkarwala and Gazipur Mandi for bus depots and charging infrastructure, while developing two new depots at Daurala and Jhuljhuli.
